say:3:1610748002:1.source_cn: 这么说，你答应帮忙了？感谢你的热心。

say:4:1610748004:1.text: I was hoping you could take a look at my sword.
say:4:1610748004:1.source_cn: 我想请你帮忙检查一下我的佩剑。
say:4:1610748004:1.male: I was hoping you could take a look at my sword.
say:4:1610748004:1.female: I was hoping you could take a look at my sword.

say:5:1610748005:1.text: You remember at the art gallery, I used that small anti-magic device.
say:5:1610748005:1.source_cn: 你也知道……当时在艺术画廊里，我使用了小型反魔法射线装置。
say:5:1610748005:1.male: You remember at the art gallery, I used that small anti-magic device.
say:5:1610748005:1.female: You remember at the art gallery, I used that small anti-magic device.

say:6:1610748006:1.text: Well, because of its side effects, my sword has been losing its magical power.
say:6:1610748006:1.source_cn: 因为反魔法射线造成的负面作用，我的随身佩剑也出了问题，...
say:6:1610748006:1.male: Well, because of its side effects, my sword has been losing its magical power.
say:6:1610748006:1.female: Well, because of its side effects, my sword has been losing its magical power.

say:7:1610748007:1.text: I'm not very skilled with alchemy or forging magic. I've tried everything I can think of, but nothing's worked to restore it.
say:7:1610748007:1.source_cn: 或许是我对炼金和锻造魔法都不擅长的缘故，我尝试了很多种...
say:7:1610748007:1.male: I'm not very skilled with alchemy or forging magic. I've tried everything I can think of, but nothing's worked to restore it.
say:7:1610748007:1.female: I'm not very skilled with alchemy or forging magic. I've tried everything I can think of, but nothing's worked to restore it.

say:8:1610748008:1.text: Could you see what's wrong with it?
say:8:1610748008:1.source_cn: 能请你检查一下它，看看它出了什么问题吗？
say:8:1610748008:1.male: Could you see what's wrong with it?
say:8:1610748008:1.female: Could you see what's wrong with it?
